name: EU AI Act (demo subset)
note: Honest demo scope, not legal completeness (D29). Representative tiers and controls only.

tiers.description: Practices the Act prohibits outright. These systems may not be deployed at all.
criteria: social scoring of individuals by general behaviour
manipulative or deceptive techniques that materially distort behaviour
real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces
emotion recognition in workplaces or schools

controls.title: Prohibited practice
controls.requirement: Do not build or deploy. Existing systems must be decommissioned.

tiers.description: Systems that decide over people's access to credit, work, education, essential services, or that run critical infrastructure.
criteria: access to essential public or private services
law enforcement or border control use

controls.title: Risk management system
controls.requirement: A documented, maintained risk assessment covering the system's lifecycle.

controls.title: Human oversight
controls.requirement: A named human can understand, intervene on, and override the system's output.

controls.title: Logging and traceability
controls.requirement: Automatic event logs sufficient to reconstruct how a decision was reached.

controls.title: Accuracy and bias testing
controls.requirement: Documented testing for accuracy, robustness and discriminatory outcomes before release.

controls.title: Registration
controls.requirement: The system is recorded in the organisation's AI register with owner and purpose.

tiers.description: Systems that interact with people or generate content. The risk is deception, so the duty is transparency.
criteria: chatbots and conversational agents facing customers
systems generating text, image, audio or video content

controls.title: AI disclosure
controls.requirement: People are told they are interacting with an AI system.

controls.title: Content labelling
controls.requirement: AI-generated content is marked as such.

tiers.description: Everything else: internal tooling, filters, recommenders with no material effect on people's rights.
criteria: batch processing with no direct effect on individuals

controls.title: Voluntary code of conduct
controls.requirement: No mandatory obligations. Follow internal AI policy as a baseline.
